sentences.text: Discosaurus belongs to the family Pliosauridae and the subfamily Brachaucheninae within the order Plesiosauria.
The holotype — the specimen the species is based on — consists of eleven vertebrae found by Joseph Jones.
Two additional specimens originally attributed to Discosaurus from New Jersey were later reclassified as Cimoliasaurus magnus.
This animal lived between 85.7 and 83.6 million years ago during the Santonian stage in Alabama and Mississippi.
